title: Welcome to Candler Park
description: José, Jeremy, and Chris are already at Candler Park, and there’s room for one more. Step onto the pitch, stretch your legs, and find a camera view that feels like home.
prompt: Move with {move}. Explore the pitch. Change camera with {camera}.

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: Hey! Look who finally showed up!

intro.speaker: Jeremy
intro.text: We were just about to start knocking it around.

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: Come on in. Grab the ball. Let's warm up.

intro.speaker: Chris
intro.text: I meant to tell you, you can click {camera} to change the camera if you want.

intro.speaker: Chris
intro.text: Try a couple different views. Whatever feels right.

transition.speaker: José
transition.text: All right, let's get some touches in.

title: First Touch
description: José wants you to get comfortable with the ball before anyone starts showing off. With Jeremy and Chris nearby, take a few touches, change direction, and settle into the afternoon’s rhythm.
prompt: Move with {move}; change direction to keep the ball close. Receive a teammate’s pass in space.

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: First things first. Just get comfortable with the ball.

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: Move around a little. Change direction. Feel how it follows you.

hint.speaker: Jeremy
hint.text: Don't worry about going fast yet. Get your feet sorted first.

transition.speaker: José
transition.text: All right. Let's bring Jeremy into this.

title: Knock It Around
description: Jeremy’s ready to knock the ball around, and José would appreciate not being left out. Trade passes with the group, find the open space, and try sending the ball straight back with a first-touch pass.
prompt: Aim with {move}. Hold {pass} for distance, release to pass.

afterPrompt.speaker: Jeremy
afterPrompt.text: You can also queue up a first-touch pass by holding {pass} while the ball is traveling to you.

intro.speaker: Jeremy
intro.text: Let's work on passing.

intro.speaker: Jeremy
intro.text: Send one over here. Then you can play it right back.

hint.speaker: Jeremy
hint.text: Look for open space. You don't always have to pass straight ahead.

transition.speaker: Jeremy
transition.text: All right, I think we're ready to pick up the pace.

title: Pick Up the Pace
description: Steven has arrived, and apparently the warm-up isn’t moving fast enough for him. Stretch your legs with a few sprints while Jeremy reminds you to leave something in the tank.
prompt: Hold {sprint} while moving. Ease off to recover stamina.

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Are we actually playing soccer or just standing around?

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: Well, somebody's in a hurry.

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Come on! Let's stretch those legs!

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Give it some speed! Try sprinting with the ball.

hint.speaker: Jeremy
hint.text: Watch your stamina. You can't go full throttle forever.

success.speaker: Steven
success.text: THERE we go! That's more like it!

transition.speaker: Steven
transition.text: Now let's see if you can get a ball out in front of me.

title: Thread the Needle
description: Nadia has a suggestion: pass to where your teammate is going, not where they’re standing. Steven’s happy to do the running—give him a through-ball worth chasing.
prompt: Aim into space and release {through} to lead a teammate’s run.

intro.speaker: Nadia
intro.text: Let's try some through-balls.

intro.speaker: Nadia
intro.text: Instead of passing to where someone is, try passing into the space they're running toward.

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Watch my run. I'll go behind José.

hint.speaker: Steven
hint.text: Almost! Try leading me a little more.

success.speaker: Steven
success.text: Again! I can get on the end of those all day.

transition.speaker: Nadia
transition.text: Of course, sometimes you're going to lose the ball...

transition.speaker: José
transition.text: Let's let the others put us under a little pressure.

title: Win It Back
description: Meghan and Daniel fancy a little two-on-two keep-away. Your partner will help apply pressure, but winning the ball back is your job—close the gap and pick your moment to tackle.
prompt: Pass with {pass} to Meghan or Daniel to start keep-away. Then use {switch} to switch and {shot} to tackle. Win it back, then pass to them to go again.

intro.speaker: Meghan
intro.text: Daniel and I will play keep-away. Two against two. If you’ve got the ball, pass it our way and try to get it back!

intro.speaker: Jeremy
intro.text: Let's work on defending.

intro.speaker: Jeremy
intro.text: Close down the space, stay in front, and time your tackle.

intro.speaker: Jeremy
intro.text: Your teammate will put us under pressure, but you need to make the tackle. Switch if you need a better angle.

hint.speaker: Jeremy
hint.text: Don't dive in too early. Wait for your moment.

success.speaker: Jeremy
success.text: That's how you win it back.

transition.speaker: Jeremy
transition.text: All right. Let's get the ball off the ground for a change.

title: Take to the Skies
description: Meghan reckons the best route past a defender might be over their head. Pam’s already calling for the ball, so send a lofted pass her way and give her time to get underneath it.
prompt: Hold and release {cross} for a lofted pass. Aim across the pitch with {move}.

intro.speaker: Meghan
intro.text: Let's try putting a little air under the ball.

intro.speaker: Meghan
intro.text: Sometimes the best way around a defender is straight over them.

intro.speaker: Pam
intro.text: Send me one! I'll make a run.

intro.speaker: Meghan
intro.text: Watch the flight of the ball. Give your teammate time to get underneath it.

transition.speaker: Meghan
transition.text: Now let's see what happens when one of those comes in toward goal.

title: Heads Up
description: Pam wants to work on headers (of course), and Meghan’s ready to help with the timing. Send in a cross, meet the ball in the air, and give Sean something to worry about in goal.
prompt: Send a cross with {cross}, then charge {shot} as the receiver meets it high. Timing and ball height determine the aerial strike.

intro.speaker: Meghan
intro.text: Let's work on headers next!

intro.speaker: Meghan
intro.text: When the ball comes in high, timing matters.

intro.speaker: Pam
intro.text: Send a cross my way, then meet it high. You’ll take control when it comes over.

intro.speaker: Sean
intro.text: Just try not to put it straight at me.

hint.speaker: Meghan
hint.text: Close! Watch where the ball's dropping.

success.speaker: Meghan
success.text: YES! That's how you attack a cross!

transition.speaker: Sean
transition.text: All right, enough of the fancy stuff. Let's see some shots.

title: Have a Crack
description: Sean’s inviting you to take a shot, and Steven’s been waiting all afternoon to hear that. Pick your spot, find the right amount of power, and see whether Sean’s confidence survives a few attempts.
prompt: Hold {shot}, aim with {move}, release to shoot. More power is not always more accurate.

intro.speaker: Sean
intro.text: All right. Take a shot.

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Finally! My favorite part!

intro.speaker: Sean
intro.text: More power isn't always better. Pick your spot.

hint.speaker: Steven
hint.text: Well... the goal's a little more to the left.

hint.speaker: Sean
hint.text: Not bad. Not getting past me, though.

success.speaker: Steven
success.text: That’s the idea! Keep picking your spot.

transition.speaker: Steven
transition.text: Okay, but what if I told you we could make those shots bend?

title: Bend It
description: Steven’s decided ordinary shots aren’t quite enough—time to put some bend on the ball. Learn to curl one toward the corner while Sean wonders why anyone thought teaching this was a good idea.
prompt: While charging {shot}, sweep {move} in a quarter or half circle, then release to impart spin.

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Want to try something fun?

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: You can put some curve on your shots.

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Try bending one around the defender and into the corner.

intro.speaker: Sean
intro.text: Oh, great. Now you're teaching everybody that?

success.speaker: Steven
success.text: That's the idea! Give it some spin!

transition.speaker: Steven
transition.text: All right. Now we're getting somewhere.

transition.speaker: José
transition.text: Speaking of getting somewhere, let's heat things up.

title: We’re Heating Up
description: José can feel the team starting to click, and Daniel wants to keep those passes flowing. Bring your teammates into the move, build up Burn, and finish the combination with something special.
prompt: Connect passes between different teammates to build Burn. At full charge Burn activates automatically; shoot during its window for a special.

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: You feel how we're starting to click?

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: The more we connect our passes, the more dangerous we get.

intro.speaker: Daniel
intro.text: Keep the ball moving. Find your teammates.

success.speaker: José
success.text: All right. Give that ball everything you've got!

success.speaker: Jeremy
success.text: Well. That's one way to do it.

transition.speaker: José
transition.text: All right, we've got enough people now.

transition.speaker: Chris
transition.text: So... are we actually going to play a game?

title: One Last Game
description: Chris calls time on the warm-up: there are enough Burners here for a proper scrimmage. Put it all together in a three-minute kickaround for bragging rights—Steven’s already planning his celebration.
prompt: Use everything you’ve learned. Play a three-minute kickaround, or finish when ready.

intro.speaker: Chris
intro.text: All right, enough warming up.

intro.speaker: Chris
intro.text: Let's split into teams and play a little scrimmage.

intro.speaker: José
intro.text: Three minutes. Winning team gets bragging rights!

intro.speaker: Steven
intro.text: Perfect. I'm already planning my celebration.

ending.speaker: Meghan
ending.text: Yeah, we should do this more often.

ending.speaker: José
ending.text: Hey, you did good out there!
